title: EHAL Telemetry-API (schema_version 4)
description: Normalized plant telemetry. Power in W; grid + = import, − = export; ess_power + = discharge, − = charge (OpenEMS-aligned). Home battery SoC is entity-scoped only (ess.{id}.sens_ess_soc). Plant AC PV is not on this document — derive from inv.{id}.sens_inv_power_pv. Field names: docs/ui/ehal-com.md §C.

sens_grid_power_active.description: PCC active power in W. + = import, − = export.

sens_ess_power.description: Optional ESS active power in W. + = discharge, − = charge.

sens_evcs_active_power.description: Optional EVCS charge power in W (≥ 0).

sens_power_consumers.description: Optional house load in W. Prefer mapped hub channel / binding; else derive from grid/PV/ESS.

get_evcs_nominal_current.description: Optional EVCS nominal / max charge current in A.

sens_evcs_bat_capacity.description: Optional EV battery capacity in kWh.

get_evcs_ready_by_time.description: Optional EV ready-by deadline (ISO-8601 or house local time string).

get_evcs_limit_soc.description: Optional EV charge limit SoC in %.

get_evcs_soc_min_immediate.description: Optional EV ASAP min SoC floor in %; ≤0 or null = inactive.

get_grid_export_power_limit.description: Optional grid-side max export power in W (inbound ceiling).

get_ess_soc_min.description: Optional ESS discharge cut-off SoC in % (device config).

get_ess_soc_max.description: Optional ESS charge cut-off SoC in % (device config).

get_ess_max_charge_power.description: Optional ESS device max charge power in W (magnitude ≥ 0).

get_ess_max_discharge_power.description: Optional ESS device max discharge power in W (magnitude ≥ 0).

sens_inv_power_ac.description: Optional inverter AC power in W (+ feeds AC bus). Live wire is entity-scoped inv.{id}.sens_inv_power_ac (2.7.l).

sens_inv_power_pv.description: Optional inverter PV input power in W (≥ 0). Live wire is entity-scoped inv.{id}.sens_inv_power_pv (2.7.l).

get_inv_max_ac_power.description: Optional inverter AC rating in W (magnitude ≥ 0). Live wire is entity-scoped inv.{id}.get_inv_max_ac_power (2.7.l).

get_inv_max_pv_power.description: Optional inverter DC/MPPT input limit in W (magnitude ≥ 0). Live wire is entity-scoped inv.{id}.get_inv_max_pv_power (2.7.l).
